import sqlite3

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')

q1 = """SELECT (curr.amount * 100.0 / prev.amount) - 100.0
FROM revenues curr
JOIN revenues prev ON curr.category = prev.category AND curr.months = prev.months
WHERE curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND curr.period_end = '2024-09-30' AND prev.period_end = '2023-09-30'"""

q2 = """SELECT (curr.amount * 100.0 / prev.amount) - 100.0
FROM activity_metrics curr
JOIN activity_metrics prev ON curr.metric = prev.metric AND curr.months = prev.months
WHERE curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND curr.period_end = '2024-06-30' AND prev.period_end = '2023-06-30'"""

q3 = """SELECT
  ((r_curr.amount * 100.0 / r_prev.amount) - 100.0) -
  ((v_curr.amount * 100.0 / v_prev.amount) - 100.0)
FROM revenues r_curr
JOIN revenues r_prev ON r_curr.category = r_prev.category AND r_curr.months = r_prev.months
CROSS JOIN activity_metrics v_curr
JOIN activity_metrics v_prev ON v_curr.metric = v_prev.metric AND v_curr.months = v_prev.months
WHERE r_curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND r_curr.period_end = '2024-09-30' AND r_prev.period_end = '2023-09-30'
AND v_curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND v_curr.period_end = '2024-06-30' AND v_prev.period_end = '2023-06-30'"""

q4 = """SELECT (r_curr.amount / 10.0) / v_curr.amount
FROM revenues r_curr
CROSS JOIN activity_metrics v_curr
WHERE r_curr.category = 'Service revenue' AND r_curr.period_end = '2024-09-30'
AND v_curr.metric = 'Nominal payments volume' AND v_curr.period_end = '2024-06-30'"""

print(conn.execute(q1).fetchone()[0])
print(conn.execute(q2).fetchone()[0])
print(conn.execute(q3).fetchone()[0])
print(conn.execute(q4).fetchone()[0])
EOF

c04:s05 - Scope of payment volume
Payments volume is an aggregate purchase-value measure for Visa-branded cards and other form factors and excludes Europe co-badged volume.
